pages.description: Buy Lily Murray: Dinosaurium, illustrated by Chris Wormell (Junior Edition) for only €17.00 at Tales for Tadpoles! This museum is open all hours. It will transport you millions of years back in time to discover the largest and most ferocious land animals that ever lived - the dinosaurs.
pages.ld_description: This museum is open all hours. It will transport you millions of years back in time to discover the largest and most ferocious land animals that ever lived - the dinosaurs. So where did the T.rex live? What did Brachiosaurus eat? Could dinosaurs swim and fly? And why did they die out? Format: Hardback
